nodes.label: CartesianImpedanceAction
nodes.rationale: Computes Cartesian wrench control, nullspace torques, and joint-limit avoidance for effort references.

nodes.label: Cartesian Nullspace Torque
nodes.rationale: Projects joint stiffness/damping toward a nullspace goal without disturbing task-space wrench control.

nodes.label: Smooth Right Pseudo-Inverse
nodes.rationale: Uses SVD of J J^T with bisquare regularization to avoid unstable Jacobian inversion.

nodes.label: Joint Limit Avoidance Torque
nodes.rationale: Adds saturating per-joint torques near configured joint position limits.

nodes.label: JointImpedanceAction
nodes.rationale: Computes joint-space PD plus feedforward effort, clamped to joint effort limits.

nodes.label: GravityCompensationAction
nodes.rationale: Builds a KDL chain from URDF and solves gravity compensation torques.

nodes.label: Engine
nodes.rationale: ROS 2 evaluation orchestrator for model validation, simulator setup, task execution, scoring, and cleanup.

nodes.label: Participant Model Lifecycle Validation
nodes.rationale: Discovers one lifecycle model node, verifies state-specific behavior, and drives configure/activate/deactivate/cleanup/shutdown transitions.

nodes.label: CheatCode
nodes.rationale: Ground-truth TF policy that aligns plug and port frames and descends the gripper into the target.

nodes.label: CheatCodeFixed
nodes.rationale: CheatCode variant with corrected unit-quaternion inverse and task-time-limit checks.

nodes.label: WaveArm
nodes.rationale: Observation-driven Cartesian pose policy that waves the gripper over the task board.

nodes.label: RunACT
nodes.rationale: Loads a Hugging Face LeRobot ACT checkpoint and converts observations into velocity commands.

nodes.label: Joint Motion Stress Policies
nodes.rationale: Policies intentionally vary stiffness, damping, and trajectories to exercise scoring penalties and jerk behavior.

nodes.label: CablePlugin
nodes.rationale: Gazebo system plugin that attaches a spawned cable to the gripper, detects port touch events, locks the cable, and publishes insertion completion.

nodes.label: OffLimitContactsPlugin
nodes.rationale: Publishes contact sensor data only when the model contacts configured off-limit models.

nodes.label: ResetJointsPlugin
nodes.rationale: Gazebo system plugin exposing a ROS ResetJoints service and applying JointPositionReset/JointVelocityReset components in PreUpdate.

nodes.label: ScoringPlugin
nodes.rationale: Publishes timestamped Gazebo scoring protobuf messages at a configured update rate.
